instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Layout & Theme: App MUST be Dark theme default with deep obsidian black (#0D0D11) and warm ember orange (#FF6B00) highlights matching Urban Burguer identity.
2. Mobile First: Prioritize fluid mobile ordering experience with horizontal scrollable category tabs, sticky bottom Cart summary bar, and high-impact visual item cards.

3. Item Customization Modal (Dialog): Clicking any item opens a rich dialog allowing quantity selection, choosing available 'Adicionais' (blend extra, bacon, queijo, ovo, molhos) with price recalculation, and custom observation text ('Sem cebola', 'Ponto da carne', etc.).

4. Cart & Checkout Drawer (Sheet/Dialog): Customer fills Name, Telefone/WhatsApp, Endereço de entrega (Rua, Número, Bairro, Complemento/Referência), Forma de Pagamento (PIX, Cartão Crédito/Débito, Dinheiro com troco) and Observações gerais.

5. Order Submission & WhatsApp: On checkout completion, save order in FastAPI backend (/api/orders) to generate unique Order ID (#UB-XXXX), then auto-format friendly WhatsApp message and offer direct button to open WhatsApp (86) 99816-6138 with full order breakdown, address, and total.

6. Admin Dashboard (/admin): Simple PIN-protected screen (Default PIN: 1234, customizable) to view live orders, filter by status ('recebido', 'preparando', 'saiu_entrega', 'entregue', 'cancelado'), update status in 1-click, and see order count & revenue summary.
7. Customer Order Tracking (/pedido/:id): Customer can visit or refresh their order status page to track status changes in real-time.
8. Seed Data: Seed comprehensive initial menu categories and items in backend/seed.py based on the cardapio specification.

9. Test IDs: All interactive buttons, category pills, inputs, add-on checkboxes, cart actions, and admin controls must include explicit data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='category-pill-especiais', data-testid='add-to-cart-button', data-testid='checkout-name-input', data-testid='admin-pin-input').
